B‑Nb3 = 20 Ω, Nb3‑Nb2 = 15 Ω, Nb2‑Nb1 = 10 Ω, Nb1‑X1 = 5 Ω.
All pairwise resistances are sums of these series values, matching the given measurements exactly. The resistors are labeled left‑to‑right (B → X1) as R1‑R4.

{
  "resistors": {"R1": 20.0, "R2": 15.0, "R3": 10.0, "R4": 5.0},
  "connections": [
    ["B", "Nb3", "R1"],
    ["Nb3", "Nb2", "R2"],
    ["Nb2", "Nb1", "R3"],
    ["Nb1", "X1", "R4"]
  ]
}
